description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Homagama, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land and property-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels in the Bulagala village area under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land ownership determinations, cadastral mapping, and title settlement procedures, which directly aligns with the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land registrations, property ownership claims, and land title matters.
